LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COMPOUND SENTENCES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we join sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify compound sentences from texts
2. construct compound sentences using different coordinating conjunctions
3. appreciate the usage of compound sentences in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COMPOUND SENTENCES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify compound sentences from texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. construct compound sentences using different coordinating conjunctions
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the usage of compound sentences in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes: Compound Sentences important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we join sentences?
2. How do we join sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify compound sentences from texts
2. construct compound sentences using different coordinating conjunctions
3. appreciate the usage of compound sentences in communication
